description: TrueNAS host metrics pushed through its Graphite reporting exporter, plus pool, vdev and SMART health pushed by the health cron job from apps/truenas.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Share of total memory not available, so ZFS ARC counts as used.

panels.title: Pool used
panels.description: Alerts fire above 80% (warning) and 90% (critical).

panels.title: Hottest disk
panels.description: Alerts fire at 50 degrees C (warning) and 60 degrees C (critical).

panels.title: ARC hit ratio
panels.description: Demand data and metadata hits over all demand reads, 5 minute average.

panels.title: Pools not ONLINE
panels.description: Pools whose state is not ONLINE, boot pool included. Alert: TrueNASPoolNotOnline.

panels.title: Vdevs not ONLINE
panels.description: Mirror and RAIDZ vdevs and the disks in them that are DEGRADED, FAULTED, OFFLINE, REMOVED or UNAVAIL. Alert: TrueNASVdevNotOnline.

panels.title: ZFS device errors
panels.description: Read, write and checksum errors ZFS counted since the pool was imported or the counters were cleared. Alert: TrueNASVdevErrors.

panels.title: Disks failing SMART
panels.description: Disks whose SMART overall health check failed. Alert: TrueNASSmartHealthFailed.

panels.title: Days since last scrub
panels.description: The pool that was scrubbed longest ago, by its last finished scrub or resilver. Scrubs run when the last one is over 35 days old. Alert: TrueNASScrubOverdue at 45 days. A pool that was never scrubbed has no value.

panels.title: Health data age
panels.description: How long ago the TrueNAS health cron job last pushed. It runs every minute. Alert: TrueNASHealthMetricsMissing after 15 minutes.

panels.title: Pools, vdevs and disks
panels.description: Every vdev and disk of every pool with its ZFS state, problems first. A removed disk shows the serial TrueNAS remembers for it.

panels.title: SMART by disk
panels.description: SMART results per disk. Healthy is 1 when the overall health check passes. Failing disks are listed first. The sector counters are blank for disks that do not report them (NVMe, many SSDs).

panels.title: ZFS device errors
panels.description: Disks with read, write or checksum errors. Only disks with a nonzero count are shown, so an empty panel is good.

panels.title: Reallocated and pending sectors
panels.description: Disks with reallocated or pending sectors. A count that keeps growing means the disk is wearing out. An empty panel is good.

panels.title: ARC size
panels.description: Reported in bytes. The ARC grows to use free memory and shrinks under pressure.

panels.title: Pool capacity
panels.description: The exporter reports the pool as one series with no pool name. It has no health, vdev or SMART data.

panels.title: Disk temperature
panels.description: Legend shows the disk serial number.

panels.title: Disk IOPS
panels.description: Reads above zero, writes below.

panels.title: Disk throughput
panels.description: Reads above zero, writes below. Reported in KiB per second.

panels.title: Network throughput
panels.description: Received above zero, sent below. Reported in kilobits per second. Includes VM tap interfaces.

panels.title: Link state
panels.description: 1 means the link has carrier, 0 means it is down. A port that never had a cable stays at 0.

panels.title: NFS throughput
panels.description: Reads above zero, writes below. Reported in KiB per second.

panels.title: VM disk I/O
panels.description: Reads above zero, writes below. Reported in KiB per second.

panels.title: VM pressure (60 s average)
panels.description: Share of time tasks in the VM wait for CPU, memory or disk.

panels.title: Service memory (top 8)
panels.description: Reported in MiB.

title: TrueNAS
